summary: Design cross-agency agreements, access controls, and governance workflows. Explore practical public-sector data-sharing training and review the course.
lede: Cross-organisation data-sharing training helps public-service teams plan information exchange with clear data flows, responsibilities and access. For CIOs, data-protection officers and programme information managers, it develops skills in mapping interoperability needs, drafting agreement provisions and setting consent and role-based access controls. Participants also assess data quality and privacy risks, then outline grievance and incident pathways for cross-agency services.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who authorize, manage, protect, or rely on cross-agency data exchange in public services and multi-partner programmes.
prerequisites: Prior experience coordinating public-service, health, social-protection, agricultural, or humanitarian information is useful. No coding or programming is required. Bring a general understanding of your organization’s data workflows; review of local legal requirements remains the responsibility of the relevant institution.
